            d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels']))
    return d

</parameter>

def bc(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:

            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels']))
    return d
